svg.title: The score matrix as causal tiles that never leave the chip
svg.desc: FlashAttention computes attention one Br x Bc score tile at a time. A Q tile of 128 rows is 32 KB, a K tile of 64 columns is 16 KB, and the score tile is 16 KB; with the matching V tile the working set is 80 KB. The L x L matrix is never written to HBM, so the 20 GB per head per layer is never materialized.
svg.text: Schematic 10 x 10 tile map. In deployment Br = 128 and Bc = 64, so the real tile grid is far larger
than shown. Blank cells are masked by causality and never computed.
